stack.title: Technology Stack
stack.description: An overview of the technologies, services, and architecture decisions that power WaveCore.
stack.backend1.title: Backend 1 · Query agent
stack.backend1.description: An independent API hosted in a separate Vercel project. It queries the required data from Supabase, sends it to Gemini for reasoning, and returns the response.
stack.backend2.title: Backend 2 · Documents and data agent
stack.backend2.description: A Render service that ingests PDFs, splits them into chunks, and stores them in Supabase. Its tool-augmented data agent queries those chunks and tables using the database schema and context.
stack.architectureDescription: The application is organized by features to keep related responsibilities together and support ongoing development.
stack.architectureNote: Clean Architecture is an architectural inspiration; this does not imply that every layer or rule of the pattern is implemented strictly.
